findings.message:
[P1] Keep the no-other-account case single-account

With the default fixture still containing accounts A and B, fencing A makes the next strong selection choose B. The unchanged no-other-account test returns 401 for both accounts and therefore makes two upstream calls, failing its `length === 1` assertion; seed that case with only A or update its expectation and name.

src/live/calls.ts:268-268

summary: The requested credential fence and A-to-B retry are implemented, but an existing failure test now performs two upstream calls and fails its one-call assertion.

evidence: The live route calls markCodexCredentialInvalid for a 401/403 before recording health and entering reselection.
The retry test retains the default A/B pool and no longer removes A before the retry, asserting that the second request uses account B.
